answer: Rewards flow only to agents whose velvet-smooth reputation accrues from verified peer attestations over epochs, so forging thousands of sybils costs more in stake and attestation effort than any single reward can repay. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a unique graph challenge: proving it controls a distinct vertex in the social graph, where colluding identities reveal a large delta between claimed and actual independence. In practice, Agent0269 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
